end.title: End reading session

end.notePlaceholder: A thought, a quote, a feeling…
end.markFinishedHelper: Moves the book to your Read shelf.
end.discardConfirm: Discard this session? The time you read in it won't be saved.

note.contentPlaceholder: A thought, a quote, a feeling…

picker.title: Which edition are you reading?
picker.description: Page counts differ between editions and translations, so progress is measured against yours.
picker.empty: No editions have been added for this book yet. Add yours, or start without one.
picker.noEditionHelper: Start now and choose the edition later.
picker.startPageHelper: Optional. The page you're starting from, up to {{max}}.
picker.startPercentHelper: Optional. How far in you already are, up to {{max}}%.

editionForm.description: Other readers will be able to pick it too.
editionForm.formatHelper: Ebooks and audiobooks track progress as a percentage.

editionForm.languageHelper: The language of this edition or translation.
editionForm.publishedAtHelper: Optional. At most one year from today.
editionForm.isbnHelper: Optional. ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, dashes allowed.

readingForm.title: Edit read-through
readingForm.description: Correct the edition, the dates or where you are.

readingForm.deleteConfirm: Delete this read-through with all its sessions and notes? This can't be undone.
